🤖 OpenAI is giving away GPT-5.6 to 100,000 researchers for free.

OpenAI has launched ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, a new program that gives scientists, mathematicians, and engineers free access to its frontier AI models.

The rollout starts with 10,000 researchers and will expand to 100,000 by 2027.

Participants get access to the GPT-5.6 family, business-grade privacy (their data isn’t used to train models by default), support for up to 4 collaborators, plus training and hands-on guidance.

The goal? Help researchers spend less time on paperwork and more time making discoveries, from writing grant proposals to testing new ideas.

Ⓜ️ Meta AI joins Threads private chats

Threads added a private chat with Meta AI, letting users send posts, photos, or videos for one-on-one discussion. This feature was already on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp before arriving on Threads.

In five countries, Meta AI also posts publicly in Threads feeds under @meta.ai. Users cannot block these posts, only mute them. The AI’s presence in feeds is permanent, unlike the optional private chats.

❗️Scientists warn SpaceX's plan to launch 1 MILLION data center satellites could turn Earth's atmosphere into a "fire pit," per NBC News.

Each satellite burns up on re-entry, pumping vaporized metal into the upper atmosphere at a scale never seen before.

SpaceX has no prototype yet, the first test satellite is not expected until 2027.
